title: Cognitive overload and rest dataset. Simultaneous EEG + PPG + ECG + eye-tracking
description: This dataset contains raw 64-channel EEG recorded simultaneously with electrocardiography, photoplethysmography, eye-tracking/pupillometry, and behavioral data from 124 healthy young adults. Recordings cover a resting-state session (alternating eyes-closed and eyes-open blocks plus passive cartoon watching) and an adaptive verbal working memory digit-span task with serial recall. The dataset supports research on cognitive overload, working memory load, and multimodal psychophysiology.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 64-channel Brain Products system, with ECG and PPG recorded via the amplifier's AUX channels. Eye-tracking and pupillometry were recorded with a Pupil Labs Core wearable eye-tracker. In the adaptive digit-span task, sequence length increased after a block of 10 trials with 7 or more correct recalls and decreased otherwise. Participants typed responses on a numpad, and the correctness of each recalled digit is stored in the event triggers.
